title: Build Grave Accord and polish rooms, maps, and recovery
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
This draft adds Grave Accord’s shared authoritative game loop, all 66 boss identities, seven class kits, 378 skills, 28 weapons, six maps and five modes. Offline Practice, public/private rooms, profiles, boundary saves and server-scoped team records are implemented. The game remains in development.

Room creation opens a waiting room with the team, host and copyable code. Only the host starts; equipment has a separate tab, and codes also work during play. A chosen map stays fixed, with separate random-once and random-per-fight options. Boss clears keep the actual position and floor for a five-second ending with one sound. Painted cover, lava and surroundings replace generic presentation across all 36 map/difficulty layouts. C toggles chat, and the upgrade footer stays clear of scrolling content.

Medic can spend a finite self-revival charge in Solo or a team, with a full two-second channel. Its revival health is Baby 100% plus a 20% shield, Easy 75%, Normal 45%, Hard 30%, Insane 1 HP and Hellish none. Other classes retain their ordinary restrictions. Hard/Insane reduce passive regeneration; Hellish disables it. One personal shield cap covers starting, ability and item shields: 100% of maximum health on lower difficulties, 75% on Hard, 50% on Insane and zero on Hellish. Tank starts each fight at 100% of that capacity, Heavy 50%, Soldier 15%, others zero. UI, item availability and authority agree. Future cap upgrades and selective attack blocking are recorded only.

Team records use authority counters and immutable SQLite results, shared team scores/ties, historical participants, filters and paging. Test runs and client-submitted scores cannot enter the board. Solo pauses; online matches continue with the existing notice.

Validation for source fe13d84c570f0eb91f67c5af07e4034943af2142: 808/808/0 locally and in both CI jobs; authored content, fifteen locales, RGBA, TypeScript, production build and 71 atlas contracts pass. [CI 123685867684](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/actions/runs/40941528605/job/123685867684); [CI 123685778637](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/actions/runs/40941503556/job/123685778637). The 191 focused checks include real two-/seven-client transport, all 42 class/difficulty starts and shared shield capacity. Frozen public/testing previews each pass 26 asset hashes, code join, host-only Start and chat, without fake public scores. Wiki 4919fc4291039733956b49025b3e99c295fbc0d2 matches 18 pages, 34 images and public hashes. Full logs and limits: reviews/medic-recovery-2026-10-29/.

The verified a0c8c56 Windows review predates newer chat/map/recovery changes. Earlier previews, original art, rejected iterations and failures remain preserved. Current human balance, browser rendering, native-language, listening, device, WAN/endurance and shared hosted rankings/recovery remain open. The older protocol-4 Site and immutable protocol-13 Windows download remain separate. This draft does not merge main, deploy the game or submit the contest.
